note: Second control set, harder than the first: every case shares the brand with the notice, and most share the kind of food too. Pre-registered before any run of the model or of the product-keyword rule. Notices are real Government of Canada food recalls, copied verbatim from the open data feed pulled 2026-11-22 (characters the feed itself garbles are kept as they are). 'recalled' accepts pull or check_lot; 'no_match' must be no_match. The cases were chosen to be the hard part of recall matching: variants of the same product, an abbreviated brand and a French label.
